note.question: What determines online e-commerce platforms, such as Amazon and Taobao, connect thousands of sellers and consumers every day?
note.overview: Online e-commerce platforms, such as Amazon and Taobao, connect thousands of sellers and consumers every day. In this work, we study how such platforms should rank products displayed to consumers and utilize the top and most salient slots. We present a model that considers consumers’ search costs and the externalities sellers impose on each other.
